title: Calamos Investments Closed-End Funds (NASDAQ: CHI, CHY, CSQ, CGO, CHW, CCD and CPZ) Announce Monthly Distributions and Required Notifications of Sources of Distribution
summary: METRO CHICAGO, Ill., Nov. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Calamos Investments®* has announced monthly distributions and sources of distributions paid in November 2026 to shareholders of its seven closed-end funds (the Funds) pursuant to the Funds' respective distribution plans.
